The '''EasyRide passenger airspeeder''',<ref name="DI3.0">''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]''</ref> also known as '''Coruscant air taxis''' were [[repulsorcraft]] vehicles that operated on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. They were used to ferry their passengers from one destination to another and were the most common [[airspeeder]]s to be found in Coruscant's [[skylane]]s.<ref name="airtaxi" /> Being allowed "free travel," these air taxis were able to leave the auto-navigating skylanes in order to take the most direct means to their destination.<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref> The EasyRide model was comparable to the [[ComfortRide passenger airspeeder|ComfortRide Passenger Airspeeder]], with the main difference being that the EasyRide was shorter in length.<ref name="HC">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref>
